department: Department of Data Science, Ying Wu College of Computing with Mathematical Sciences

deadline.value: The page gives October 15 (spring) and December 15 (fall) with no year.

gre_general.value: The data science PhD requires GRE scores, evaluated with other NJIT PhD programs.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are required. They will be evaluated in agreement with other Ph.D. programs at NJIT.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page says advisors are identified after admission, but does not state an admission rule.

funding.value: The page does not state how many admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in a related field, with an expected GPA of 3.5 out of 4.0, is the minimum entry requirement.
entry_route.quote: A Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, informatics, mathematics/statistics, engineering, or another closely related discipline

english_waiver.value: Exemption is possible for degrees from a country where all instruction is in English.
english_waiver.quote: Exemptions can be granted to applicants who have earned (or will earn, before enrolling at NJIT) a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctoral degree from a university of recognized standing in a country in which all instruction is provided in English.

fee_waiver.value: Qualifying applicants may get an application fee waiver by contacting the program director.
fee_waiver.quote: Qualifying students may be eligible for an application fee waiver

notes: Statistics track administered by Mathematical Sciences; the statistics field is covered in the math record.
name: Ph.D. in Data Science (computing and statistics tracks)
